p, k = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 1000000007

def pow_mod(base, exponent):
    result = 1
    while exponent > 0:
        if exponent & 1:
            result = (result * base) % MOD
        exponent >>= 1
        base = (base * base) % MOD
    return result

if k == 0:
    print(pow_mod(p, p - 1))
    exit()
if k == 1:
    print(pow_mod(p, p))
    exit()

visited_nodes = [False] * p
group_count = 0

for i in range(1, p):
    if visited_nodes[i]:
        continue
    j = i
    while not visited_nodes[j]:
        visited_nodes[j] = True
        j = (j * k) % p
    group_count += 1

print(pow_mod(p, group_count))
